articleTitle: A Model of the Assessment of an Induction Motor Condition and Operation Life, Based on the Measurement of the External Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The paper presents a method for the assessment of an induction motor condition and operation life, based on the measurement of the external magnetic field on the grounds of the distance metrics. We used the Busemann metrics to develop the criteria for the assessment of the degree of asymmetry of the motor, overheating of its stator windings and the reduction of their insulation life. We found a linear dependence between the winding insulation lifespan and the relative value of the Busemann distance. The obtained results enable a quantitative assessment of the operability of an induction motor and its operation life.

articleTitle: Detection of Accident Causes on Turbine-Generator Sets by Means of Numerical Simulations
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The method for an identification of accident causes of turbine-generator sets is suggested. The accident causes can be factors, which are related to the failure of an equipment, and technological factors. For example, a deviation of the structural components from design values is related to these technological factors. The suggested approach is interdisciplinary as a gas dynamic behavior, thermal fields and a dynamic stress-strain state of the bladed disk are analyzed jointly. The approach is based on numerical methods of a gas dynamics and a dynamic strength. The vapor flow through the turbo machine blade lattice is calculated using the viscous compressible gas model. For a numerical integration of the structure a nonlinear finite element model is applied to analyze forced vibrations of the bladed disk under an action of aerodynamic loads.

articleTitle: Axial Flux Permanent Magnet Controlled Generator
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: This paper deals with axial flux permanent magnet generator with extended functionality which allows to control magnetic flux to change output voltage and stabilize external characteristics of generator. A mathematical model of electrical machine in the coordinate system (d-q) was obtained to simulate transients and external characteristics in Matlab Simulink. An experimental generator was designed, manufactured and tested.

articleTitle: Influence of Direct Lightning Strikes and Lightning Strikes Near Power Lines with Protected and Non-Insulated Wires
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: Many years of experience in the construction and operation of 6 - 35 kV overhead power lines with bare wires showed insufficient reliability of such lines and their increased danger. One of the main causes of accidents and violations are thunderous overcharging on overhead lines, causing impulse overlap and destruction of insulators and leading to arc closures, with collateral damage to equipment, line outages. Emergency outages of 6 -35 kV overhead lines due to lightning overvoltages account for up to 40% of the total number of their trips. Due to low impulse strength, insulation of distribution networks is subject to overlapping both from over voltages in direct lightning discharges and from induced overvoltages in the case of lightning near the line. The latter are the main cause of thunderstorm outages and damage to the equipment of 6 -35 kV lines, amounting to 90% in some cases, and when the overhead lines highway passes through the forest and up to 100% of their total number. Thus, reliability of power supply to consumers largely depends on the effectiveness of lightning protection measures.

articleTitle: The Formed Autonomous Source for Power Supply of Single-Phase Consumers on the Basis of the Three-Phase Asynchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The work of a three-phase autonomous asynchronous generator with controlled capacitive excitation in asymmetric loading conditions is considered. The quality parameters of output voltage of a three-phase autonomous asynchronous generator operating on single-phase electric power consumers are investigated. The application of the phase-by-phase adjusting system of the generator output voltage with relay control of capacitive excitation is based, providing the desired amount of generated electricity in all operation modes, in particular when single-phase consumers are connected, by balancing the output voltage and increasing its control range.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Parameters Determination of Power Transformers
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: An integral-differential model of electromagnetic energy conversion in the active part of a power transformer is proposed. It allows taking into account the influence of design parameters, nonlinearities of the electro physical and magnetic properties of active materials on changes in magnetizing currents during the operation of LTC. A new effective technique for calculating the currents of a power transformer based on 3D field simulation data of electromagnetic processes in a power transformer is developed and implemented. It has high accuracy, simplicity of numerical realization. Its application allows reducing the error in calculating the magnetizing currents of the transformer up 15 to 23% in comparison with their estimation according to the rated data of the open-circuited mode or by well-known techniques.

articleTitle: An Error Estimation Of The Current Sensors Of The Automated Control System Of The Technological Process Of Graphitation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The influence of structural factors on the error of current sensors with magnetic coil, which placed on the electrodes of the AC graphitization furnace, is researched. Quantitative estimation of error components, based on mathematical modeling of electromagnetic fields is performed. The calculation technique with the use of correcting coefficients, which ensures high accuracy of measurements is developed.

articleTitle: Parameters Determination of the Trolley Busbars by Electromagnetic Field Simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The mathematical model of electromagnetic processes in basbar's trolleys, which taking into account the design parameters, the nonlinearity of magnetic properties, the influence of harmonic components of currents and voltages, is proposed. Based on mathematical model implementation, a technique for calculating electrical parameters and characteristics of busbar's trolleys was proposed. The influence of harmonic current components on the active power losses was estimated. The presence of harmonic current components, which limits of the standard leads to an additional increase in losses by 3%. However, when the standardized values are exceeded, their effect increases on the active power losses.

articleTitle: Analysis of three-phase parallel active power filter operation mode with arc furnace active power’s fluctuations
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: An electrical arc furnace is the most widely used technological equipment within metallurgical industry. However, the arc furnace is characterized by the pronounced stochastic operation mode. The arc forming process in the arc furnace (which is accompanied by generation of reactive power, higher harmonics, emergence of asymmetry of currents into the power supply network) leads to reactive and active power's fluctuations. Traditional compensating devices (condenser batteries, power passive filters, synchronous compensators) have insufficient operation speed to react in time to the sharply variable operation mode of the arc furnace. One of the latest advance in the reactive power compensation is the use of active power filters. They exclude the possibility of electrical resonance arising, as well as they timely react to change the load during their acting. In frame of this work the model of the arc furnace with the three-phase active power filter (using the visual modeling environment) was synthesized. The primary side's parameters of the arc furnace transformer's equivalent circuit were referred to its secondary side. In frame of this work the furnace's active and reactive power consumption data and appropriate total harmonics distortion values was obtained for both the load and the power network currents. The oscilloscope waveforms of the power network's current and voltage, power active filter 's and load's currents and the spectral diagram of the higher harmonics of load's and the power network's currents were obtained. The presented conclusion is based on the analysis of obtained data.

articleTitle: Analyses of Energy Efficiency of Interleaving in Active Voltage-Source Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The paper presents the results of the study of energy parameters of high power multi-bridge active rectifiers in the interleaving mode. Obtained the regulating characteristic of output voltage in active rectifier in rectification mode and recuperation mode. Developed Matlab / SymPowerSystems models of multi-bridge active rectifiers with a different number of parallel bridges and different PWM frequencies in interleaving mode. According to the performed modeling were analyzed spectrum of input current harmonic and defined power losses in supply grid caused by higher current.

articleTitle: Combination of Distributed MPPT and Distributed Supercapacitor Energy Storage Based on Cascaded Converter in Photovoltaic Installation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: This paper presents a proposal for a new architecture of a stand-alone/grid-connection small photovoltaic (PV) installation based on a cascaded half-bridge DC-DC converter. Cascaded configuration provides distributed maximum power point tracking (MPPT), which increase power generation, but is more complex and more expensive. Furthermore, boost topology of DC-DC converters in cascaded configuration does not efficient works in the cases of mismatch in solar panels conditioned of the different types of PV panels, they partial shading, aging, or manufacturing variation. We propose to introduce in each a channel of cascaded DC-DC converter a supercapacitor (SC) pack combining distributed MPPT with distributed energy storage. Setting the SC pack in each a channel between the PV panel and the DC-DC converter enables using of SC pack for simple MPPT control and simultaneously power decoupling of energy generation stage from energy consumption. The latter allows improving distributed control of DC-DC boost converters in cascade with series connected outputs. To control of proposed PV installation,it has been developed some control subsystems: searching MPPT with one current sensor, flatness interleaving control of DC-bus voltage, balancing of SC voltages, energy management system (EMS). The conducted simulation studies in the Matlab/Simulink environment showed the workability and effectiveness of the proposed solution.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Energy Consumption on Performance of Handling Operations Taking Into Account Parameters of the Grasping System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: In this article the research of process of transportation of an object of manipulation on a rectilinear trajectory with optimization of Bernoulli gripping device orientation at different parameters of grasping system was made. Here offered dependence for calculation of coordinates of the center of masses of grasping system and its moment of inertia. Graphic dependences of influence of mass of the “extender-gripper-object” system on total motor power and total motor energy are shown. The energy efficiency of handling operations for different parameters of grasping system and the mass of an object of manipulation was investigated.

articleTitle: Intelligent Locomotive Decision Support System Structure Development and Operation Quality Assessment
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The design stages have been developed and the structure of the locomotive decision support system, which incorporates the features of the railway transport operation has been obtained. To take into account not only quantitative, but also qualitative characteristics of the locomotive driver or intellectual decision support system, it is proposed to use fuzzy logic methods. Hence it was possible to determine and calculate the additive quality criterion of the intellectual system controlling activity. The results of the work make it possible to model the activity of the locomotive brigade more qualitatively, which in the future will serve as the basis for the development of autonomous intelligent locomotive control systems. The developed method is given for three main criteria of work considering safety, energy consumption and implementation of the traffic schedule. However, for a more flexible and accurate modelling, this approach allows the introduction of additional criteria, and the simplicity of calculation provides the necessary speed when implemented on the on-board locomotive computers.

articleTitle: Full Soft Switching Dual DC/DC Converter With Four-Quadrant Switch for Systems With Battery Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: This paper describes topology and control algorithm for a two-stage bidirectional isolated converter with controlled semiconductors with the voltage-fed (VF) and current-fed (CF) stages. A four-quadrant bidirectional switch is connected in series with the transformer winding in the CF stage. For the energy transfer mode from the CF stage to the VF stage, a separated-commutation switching algorithm that provides a zero-current switching turn-off mode and an inductive snubber turn-on mode for the CF switches, and a zero-voltage-switching and capacitive snubber turn-off mode for the VF switches is described. Leakage inductance of the transformer is used as an inductive snubber. The influence of resonant phenomena on the VF transistors snubber switching-off process is taken into account. The topology is proposed for high power battery energy storage systems. The proposed ideas are verified with simulations in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Residential Uninterruptible Power Supply System with Renewable Energy Sources and Battery Pack
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: A residential power supply system incorporating renewable energy sources and UPS capability is proposed. The unique feature of proposed system is that it does not allow energy flow into the grid, thus eliminating the necessity of replacing conventional unidirectional energy meter with bidirectional one. As far as system is equipped with battery pack, it can provide an uninterruptible power supply capability while being disconnected from electric grid during power outage.

articleTitle: About Electromagnetic Compatibility of Rail Circuits With the Traction Supply System of Railway
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The paper deals with the determination of spectrum composition of traction current at the a. c. and d. c. traction. The most dangerous interferences are 50, 75 and 100 Hz harmonics for normal work of rail circuits at the d. c. traction. The harmonics, coinciding with the code frequency (25 Hz), are inadmissible for the rail circuits of railway section at the a. c. traction. The station rail circuits are protected from interference well enough.

articleTitle: Optimal Components Design for Modified Z-Source Based IPT Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: this paper describes components estimation process for IPT approach based on Z-source network. Proposed model covers main parameters of the system and gives efficient way to evaluate optimal parameters for fixed switching frequency and distance.

articleTitle: Analysis of Frontal Resistance Force Influence During Manipulation of Dimensional Objects
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: In this article influence of force of frontal resistance of air, acting on object of manipulation in the course of its transportation on a rectilinear trajectory, on the necessary loading capacity of Bernoulli gripping device is analyzed. The analytical dependences are provided for calculation of force of frontal resistance of air considering orientation of an object of manipulation during transportation. The main consistent patterns of influence of speed of transportation of an object of manipulation and its dimensions on force of frontal resistance of air are determined. Need of accounting for design models influence of forces of frontal resistance of air when determining the minimum necessary lifting force of Bernoulli gripping device is proved.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Verification of Low Power Wireless Charging Battery System for Electric Bicycle
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the development and research of the battery wireless charging system for the electric bicycle. The reactive power compensation method is discussed and selected; the passive components are estimated for nominal operation point. Type of control method, suitable for constant current and constant voltage mode is selected. The simulation verification is performed by means of PSIM simulation tool. Proposed solution is verified, wireless charger system works with high efficiency at CC charger mode.

articleTitle: Topological Task of Distributed Generation Placement Using a Pareto optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: It is suggested to use the topological task (TT) for select the placement of distributed generation (DG). A TT can't be solved by methods of functional analysis, because it is a problem with variable parameters. The solution of the TT is suggested to represent in the form of the Pareto-optimal area. Nonlinearity of target functions of the TT of DG placement leads to the expansion of the Pareto-optimal solutions in the direction of the global extremums according to certain criteria. It is shown that TT can be described analytically, provided that the conduction cross sections are unchanged in the domain of admissible solutions. In this case, the polygon of the objective functions extremums sufficiently clearly describes the Pareto set. This situation will be observed with considerable resistance of the power electrical system source both at autonomous feeding of consumers from DG, and at work of DG in parallel with the power system. Changing the cross sections of conductors due to the implementation of technical limitations on emergency modes causes the first-order gap in the target functions. This leads to a significant expansion of the Pareto set. At the same time, the growth of the numerical values of individual criteria on the boundary of the Pareto set can be doubled in comparison with the minimum values. This should be taken into account when making a final decision on the placement of the DG.

articleTitle: Solving the hydrodynamical tasks using CFD programs
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The possibility of performing hydrodynamic calculations in hydraulic machines using CFD software packages was considered. The main steps of the process of setting and solving the tasks were determined. Numerical studies of the spatial flow of fluid in the flow parts of hydraulic machines were carried out on the example of the bulb-type turbine, the reversible hydraulic machine and the centrifugal submersible pump. The results of calculations, namely, the visualization of the flow in the form of velocity distribution and pressure distribution, are presented. The analysis of the convergence of the results of numerical research with experimental data on the basis of determining the hydraulic coefficient of efficiency of the considering machines was carried out.

articleTitle: Estimation of Energy Efficiency of the Frequency Converter Based on the Resonant Inverter with Pulse-Density Control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The analysis of dynamic and static losses of the resonant frequency converter, which forms the sinusoidal output voltage smoothing the high-frequency sinusoidal pulses with the LC-filter, is carried out. A comparative estimation of the power losses of the resonant frequency converter and the converter with power transistors hard switching is performed. During the converter power losses estimation the transistors' losses, the static and dynamic losses on the diodes, which provide the continuous current through the output filter inductance, and the resonant circuit losses were considered.

articleTitle: The Ways of Stabilization of High-Current Glow Discharge in Welding
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The ways of stabilization of DC normal glow discharge at medium pressure 1.33...13.3 kPa and discharge currents 1...30 A under conditions of diffusion welding is considered. It is shown that the stable high-current glow discharge can be provided by inclusion of the external active resistance in the discharge gap with value not less than 80...100% of the discharge value. Alternatively, it could be done by the use of power sources with the inductive-capacitive converters. It is also shown that the region of the glow discharge stable existence can be increased by 1.6...1.7 times by replacing a monolithic anode with a multi-section one.

articleTitle: Energy Co-ops as a Driver for Bio-Energy Sector Growth in Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The paper deals with the assessment of economic benefits from biogas projects realization within energy co-operatives in Ukraine. The implemented state support tools for renewable energy growth in Ukraine caused significant disparities in the various renewable energy technologies development, where the bio-energy sector, in particular electricity generation based on animal waste, takes the last position. Based on the analysis, it has been proved that the main barriers for biogas sector development are the need for significant initial investments to construct profitable biogas plants and a large amount of raw materials for their uninterrupted operation. In order to eliminate these barriers, it is proposed to combine the financial and raw material resources of small farms within energy co-operatives. The results of the research prove that the realization such biogas projects makes economic sense and can provide significant financial benefits for the farms' owners.

articleTitle: Analysis of Gas Content in High Voltage Equipment With Partial Discharges
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The paper presents the results of gas content analysis for 284 units of high-voltage equipment, with partial discharges of varying intensity. The values of the percentage of gases in the oil samples, the values of the gas ratios and the graphic reference areas for 15 groups of equipment in which partial discharges are found, are given and which differ in gases content as well as in gas ratios values. A comparative analysis of the reliability of the recognition of these defects is performed using five known standards and the Duval triangle.

articleTitle: Forming of Current of the Single-Phase Grid Inverter of Local Combined Power Supply System with a Photovoltaic Solar Battery
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The features of realizing of mode of the current source in a single-phase grid inverter with the combination of the power active filter function for the combined power supply system of a local object with a photovoltaic solar battery and with connection to alternating current grid are considered. The choice of the circuit parameters is justified taking into account the nonlinear load. The comparison of various principles of the formation of instantaneous value of a current of the inverter is performed. The use of the relay controller of a current with combined modulation in combination with a modified algorithm of switching the inverter's keys is proposed. It allows improving the harmonic composition of the grid current while reducing the energy losses in the inverter's keys. A mathematical model of the system "a grid AC - a grid inverter - the load" with a block for determining the power losses in the keys is developed.

articleTitle: Parametric Synthesis of Electromechanical Servo Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The method of multiobjective parametric synthesis of nonlinear robust electromechanical servo systems with parametric uncertainty is developed. Matrices of the gain coefficients of the linear feedbacks state regulator and the linear observer are determined on the basis of the vector minimax nonlinear programming problem solution. Components of the vector goal function are the direct quality indicators that are presented to the system in different modes of operation. Vector minimax nonlinear programming problem solution based on stochastic multi-agent multi swarm optimization algorithm. The results of modeling and experimental research of the dynamic characteristics of a synthesized nonlinear electromechanical servo system are presented.

Author Keywords: stochastic multi agent multi swarm optimization

articleTitle: Evaluating and Ensuring the Cybersecurity of Power Line Remote Monitoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The article analyzes cyber threats for power line remote monitoring systems using UAVs. Possible attack vectors of cyber attacks on the UAV equipment used for power line monitoring are shown. An improved method for the evaluation of security threats and their associated risks is provided, which allows to estimate the robustness of the monitoring systems to cyber attacks. A set of measures is described, aimed at increasing the sustainability of the power line monitoring system to cyber attacks by increasing the resources necessary to carry out attacks, both in terms of energy and equipment required.

articleTitle: Load Characteristics of the Serial-to-serial Resonant Converter with Pulse-number Regulation for Contactless Inductive Energy Transfer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The analytical dependence of the average value of the resonant converter for contactless inductive energy transfer output current was received. It allowed building the theoretical load characteristics of the converter. To confirm the theoretical results, a simulation model of the resonant converter for the contactless battery charging was designed. The comparison of the load characteristics obtained due to the computer simulation and calculated according to the received dependences was produced.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency of Microgrid Implementation with Solar Photovoltaic Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The work with the use of simulation in the software Matlab / Simulink / SymPowerSystems environment considers construction of a local Smart Grid energy supply system with distributed solar power plants. The obtained model allows us to investigate the work of the intelligent network in any quasi-steady and transitional modes, including emergency ones. A distinctive feature of the proposed model is the localization of places for the installation of power active filter-compensating devices, the use of which allows providing the necessary quality of electric energy and achieving the minimum energy losses in the elements of the energy supply system. According to the results of the simulation, the comparison of the energy efficiency of the traditional energy supply system and Smart Grid has been made.

articleTitle: Six-Phase Multi-Inverter System with Power Balancing and Voltage Waveform Symmetries
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: Analysis of operation of four-inverter-based system with split-phase (dual three-phase) induction motor under condition of the required power balancing capability of dc sources has been done. It has been shown, that modified algorithms of discontinuous space-vector modulation with the 30<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>-non-switching intervals allow providing both power balancing operation and improved spectral composition of the phase and line-to-line voltages of six-phase system. Results of simulation illustrate behavior of system under different control modes.

articleTitle: Robust Passivity-Based Controllers for Fast Output Voltage Regulated, Non-Ideal DC-DC Boost Converter in Hamiltonian Representation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: This paper presents all possibilities of the interconnection and damping assignment (IDA) procedure of passivity-based (PB) controller synthesis for DC-DC boost converter. In order to receive a universal control system, have been used all tree control parameters of damping and interconnection. Especially, introduction the interconnection allowed to dynamically modify the object's structure instead of forming control signal as external influence in current system. That leads to better results of speed response of the output voltage in transient and its error in steady state than only damping actions. Obtained dynamic feedback PB controllers have been compared by computer simulation with others, in particular cascaded structures based on flatness and sliding mode control. Developed control system shows a robustness to system non-ideality, which have not considered during a controller synthesis. Furthermore, because of the signal of the duty ratio is forming with the use of dynamically obtained reference signal of the inductor current, there is the possibility of saturation of the latter that was realized.

articleTitle: Selective Compensation of Current Harmonics in Grid-Connected Doubly-Fed Induction Generator based Wind Energy System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: This paper presents a new approach for simultaneous selective compensation of current harmonics and reactive power compensation in grid-connected doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) based wind energy system. The proposed control algorithms are applied to the DFIG with a stator directly connected to the grid, and the rotor connected to the grid through a converter with a bi-directional energy flow. Depending on the power of the converter, the power quality can be improved by compensating the reactive power and harmonics of the grid current. It is proposed to use the observer based scheme to estimate current harmonics of the nonlinear load. This task is performed in a d-q reference frame where active and reactive current components are obvious. Positive and negative sequences are distinguished for selective compensation. Simulation results for a 2 MW DFIG confirm the effectiveness and the performance of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Modeling Of Electrical Supply Restoration In Local Electrical Systems After Loss Of Centralized Power
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: Among the complex of tasks that arise in the process of implementation of IDE, it is expedient to study and solve first of all those that directly affect the reliability and quality of electricity supply of electricity consumers. In this paper, the possibility of using small hydroelectric power plant (HPP) and determination of their installed capacity for the supply and / or maintenance of an appropriate voltage level on photovoltaic (PV) buses is investigated. Analysis of the transient process that occurs during the loss of centralized power is carried out. The influence of PV generation on the quality of electricity in the event of loss of centralized power was positively influenced and the timing of the possible functioning of the forest, whose consumers are fed exclusively from renewable energy sources, were determined.

articleTitle: Adaptive Filter of Input Information Signal for Discharge Pulse Installation Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The synthesis of optimal filter, that supplies the maximal accuracy of informational coordinate estimation for control system of the discharge pulse installation, was done. The proofs of dependence between optimal value of the filter's coefficients and the change rate of the average value and dispersion of input informational signal were given. Also the coefficients of two-section recursive adaptive filter were calculated. Application of the developed filter improves efficiency of discharge pulse installations.

articleTitle: A Pulse-Width Regulation of a Compound Excitation System for a Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The article presents the analysis of the transient and steady-state modes of the synchronous generator with current compound excitation system and DC/DC converter for excitation regulation The research is performed by using the method of mathematical modeling. The adequacy of the model is confirmed by the experimental results. The currents' distribution in the excitation system of the synchronous generator with current compound excitation system is described analytically.

articleTitle: Modeling and Active Shielding of Magnetic Field in Residential Buildings Located near Group of High Voltage Power Lines
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: Modeling of the magnetic field generated in the residential zone by a group of overhead high-voltage power lines carried out. A single-circuit active shielding system with single compensation coil for this magnetic field synthesized based on multiobjective approach. It is show, that synthesized active screening system can reduction magnetic field induction to the magnetic field sanitary standards level in a residential area located near the group of overhead high-voltage power lines. Field experimental research of the full scale active shielding system layout carried out. It is shown that the experimental and calculated magnetic field induction values differ by not more than 20%.

Author Keywords: group of overhead high-voltage power lines

articleTitle: Meteorological Parameters Analysis for hourly Forecast of Electricity Generation by Photovoltaic Power Station on the Day Ahead
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The paper presents an analysis of the mechanisms of functioning of the new model of the wholesale electricity market. According to this, the work of stations based on the using renewable energy sources (RSE), in particular photovoltaic power stations (PPS), should take place on the basis of the announced hourly generating graph by the owner of the station one day ahead. In order to ensure the accuracy of the predicted graph, a study was carried out on the determination of meteorological parameters that most affected the generation of electricity at photovoltaic power plants. Results of cluster and regression analysis were conducted on the basis of meteorological data, measured at the station located in the Vinnitsa region.

articleTitle: 18-Pulse Rectifier with Electronic Phase Shifting and Pulse Width Modulation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: At present, 12-pulse rectifiers with electronic phase shift are known. Unlike classic rectifiers, they do not use phase-shifting transformers and have a unit power factor. Increasing of the rectifier's pulse makes it possible to improve the harmonic composition of the input current. This article is devoted to the study of the operation of an 18-pulse rectifier with an electronic phase shift. The use of the principle of electronic phase shift leads to different levels of constant voltage at the output of the rectifiers. The introduction of pulse-width modulation contributes to equalizing the output voltages of the 6-pulse rectifiers which are the parts of the converter. In addition, the use of the pulse-width modulation allows eliminating matching magnetic elements which are used to equalize rectifiers output voltages. This improves the mass and dimension parameters of the converter. The results of modeling are presented.

articleTitle: On the Influence of Electromagnetic Processes of Power Transformer on Parameters of Normal Regime of Electric Network Operation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: Article provides mathematical model of normal regimes of electrical network in the form of nodal equations. With the help of vector measurement technology such models allow to control regimes in real time and to estimate the real state of the electrical network. The correlation between electromagnetic processes of power transformer and distributive electrical network regimes is established. With the help of the system of synchronous measurements received daily graphs load power transformer. The influence of electromagnetic processes of power transformer on parameters of normal regimes of electric networks operation is established. Generalized analysis of experimental researches is carried out, the regulating and control effect of transformer is established.

articleTitle: Analysis of Efficiency Of Primary Load-Frequency Control of Integrated Power System of Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: According to the results of experimental trials the verification of models of the thermal power plant (TPP) units involved in primary load-frequency control has been conducted. The model-based analysis of power system operation mode of nuclear power plant unit in switched off node for considered cases of primary system control adjustments has been completed and results has been presented. Analysis of the contribution of TPP units to the primary load-frequency control has been performed.

articleTitle: Maximum Permissible Value Correction for Dielectric Loss Tangent of 110 kV Air-Tight Bushing Basic Insulation Subject to Operational Factors Impact
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The paper presents a maximum permissible value determination technique for dielectric loss tangent (tgδ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>) of high-voltage bushing basic insulation with application of a minimum risk method. A statistical data processing procedure under insufficient measurement data is applied to results of periodic monitoring of the equipment insulation condition. Dielectric loss tangent distribution is analyzed for operational and faulty bushings. Maximum permissible values of dielectric loss tangent are specified to ensure minimum risk. Factors affecting maximum permissible values of tgδ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> are analyzed.

articleTitle: Cell Equalizer for Series-connected Lithium Batteries
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: To compensate for power pulsations in the DC power supply network used battery energy storage system (BESS) is proposed. To ensure the normal operation of the BESS, it is necessary to use service converters that provide balancing of voltage levels on series-connected storages. The modes of operation of converters of this class are analyzed. The efficiency of the use of capacitive and inductive buffer elements in the structure of active balancing systems is determined. A balancing system with improved characteristics based on transformer topology and a forecasting control system is proposed.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Spectral Composition of the Input Currents of a Three-to-One-Phase Matrix Converter at Sector Boundaries
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: This paper describes a new modulation concept for the three-to-one matrix converter, which decreases input current distortions at the mains voltage sector boundaries. This implies shifting of output voltage pulses during the switching period in such a way that the switching period always starts with the pulse having maximum amplitude, then goes a lower amplitude pulse and modulation period ends with the zero-voltage pulse. The simulation confirmed the effectiveness of this approach.

articleTitle: Voltage Harmonic Distortion in Autonomous Electric Power System with an Adjustable Power Line Conditioner
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: An improved analytical method for estimating of voltage harmonic distortions in autonomous electric power system (AEPS) with powerful semiconductor converter (SC) and hybrid adjustable power line conditioner (APLS) had been proposed. APLC consists an uncontrolled resonant filter and PWM controlled reactor compensator. An analysis of piecewise function of voltage in steady state regime of the system is fulfilled. The analysis is taking into account the influence of its elements and their parameters. Analytical expressions for the voltage harmonic distortion factor were obtained taking into account the entire voltage harmonics spectrum in a closed finite form. The comparison of analytical calculations and computer simulation results had been executed.

Author Keywords: inactive components of the total power
voltage and current harmonic distortion factors

articleTitle: The Efficient Power Supply Scheme of Alternating Current Electric Arc Furnaces
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: Alternating current electric arc furnaces negatively influence the electrical grid that often causes power quality decrease. The traditionally applied measures and methods aim to at reduce or eliminate the consequences of such influence. This study proposed a schematic solution that targets the source of the influence and reduces the extent of negative factor generation. The proposed solution decreases the negative electromagnetic effect on a power supply grid and improves the furnace performance, through: increasing the furnace efficiency, reducing the voltage fluctuations in the electrical grid by 4 times, equalizing phase loads, simplifying the power control of the furnace decreasing the power losses in the electrical grid, reducing the dynamic efforts for electrical equipment.

articleTitle: Efficiency of a Linear Pulse Electromechanical Converter of Induction Type with a Two-section Power Capacitor of Energy
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: Linear pulsed electromechanical converters (LPEC) make it possible to provide a high speed of the actuator on a short active section, and/or powerful power pulses with a slight displacement of it. Recurrence relations are obtained for the electromagnetic, mechanical and thermal parameters of the LPEC with a power circuit using polar capacitive energy storage (CES). Peculiarities of electromechanical processes in LPEC are established when feeding from a two-section CES when operating in high-speed and shock-power modes. When operating in a high-speed mode, the LPEC with a two-cell CES provides increased electromechanical performance, but these results in a stronger heating of the inductor and armature. When working in shock-power mode in comparison with the speed mode, the amplitude of electrodynamics forces increases by 3.53 times, and their momentum by 5.27 times. Reduction of the capacity of the primary section of the CES while maintaining the overall energy of the CES provides for an increase in the electromechanical and power performance of the LPEC. The experimental characteristics of the LPEC have the same regularities as the calculated characteristics, and the experimental and calculated values agree to within 5-7%.

articleTitle: Adaptive Current Control for Shunt Active Power Filters Under Resistance and Inductance Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: This paper deals with harmonic content reduction and reactive power compensation in three-phase grids through shunt active filter implementation. The presented control strategy consists of the Luenberger observer for selective current harmonics estimation and the adaptive current controller. The adaptive current controller is designed using the Lyapunov second method and guarantees the identification of unknown resistance and inductance of the filter as well as asymptotic current control and harmonic distortion rejection. The simulation studies prove theoretical findings.

articleTitle: Efficiency of Application of Electric Fields in Biogas Plants at Different Temperature Modes
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The article highlights the possibility of increasing the efficiency of biogas plants by influence on substrate by an electrical field. The results of researches on determination of optimal range of electric and thermal influence are analyzed.

articleTitle: Determination of the Conditions of Inception of an Upward Leader From Grounded Objects in Thunderstorm Conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The analytical expressions for potentials and electric field (EF) strength of conductive thin elongated spheroids, to which U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> voltage is applied or which are located in external EF with E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> strength are systematized. These expressions have been used for determination of the grounded objects parameters, which enable inception of the upward leaders from them in thunderstorm conditions.

Author Keywords: electric field of an elongated spheroid

articleTitle: Analysis of Modern Geoinformation Systems for Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: Renewable energy projects are actively developing around the world. This leads to the task of assessing the feasibility and efficiency of using renewable energy sources in a certain area. To solve a complex of various tasks in this area, it is expedient to use geoinformation technologies. The paper provides an overview of the existing GIS projects in the world for renewable energy. Possible approaches to the creation of similar geoinformation systems in Ukraine are considered.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modelling of the Electric Field in Systems With Conductive Rods for Lightning Protection
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: A technique for numerical calculation of the electric field distribution in the area around conductive rods with rather big ratio between their length and radius (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and more) has been proposed. Calculations of the electric fields through scalar electric potential using modified final integration technique and absorbing boundary conditions have been performed.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model, Research and Improvement of the Switched Reluctance Generator Voltage Stabilization Methods
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: A mathematical model of the switched reluctance generator is developed, taking into account losses in windings, magnetic losses and core saturation. The adequacy of the model is verified by comparing the instantaneous values of the phase currents of the proposed model with the known one. The methods of generator voltage stabilization by changing the commutation angles and by regulating the average value of the stator winding current are investigated, the advantages and drawbacks of each method are analyzed. It is recommended to use in practice more efficient method of adjusting the average value of the stator current.

articleTitle: Intensification of Biogas Fermentation Processes in the Bioenergy System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: A method for intensifying and controlling the processes of anaerobic fermentation is developed. Modeling and experimental study of the processes of the influence of an oscillating magnetic field on the water substrates of various biomass wastes was performed.

articleTitle: The Incentive Scheme for Maintaining or Improving Power Supply Quality
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The scheme for realization in system of automated control by the distributive company is offered. System Average Interruption Duration Index as dependent variable and territorial subdivisions of distribution network as independent variable in one-way analysis of variance are proposed. Examples of use System Average Interruption Duration Index as the Key Performance Indicators for an annual estimation of territorial subdivisions and workers of the distributive companies are examined.

articleTitle: The Development of Technology CdTe and CdS Layers for Thin-Film Solar Cells Creation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: Under optimization of the cadmium telluride base layers deposited by thermal vacuum evaporation it has been established that the main defects of the structure, namely twins and stacking faults, accompany to the <;111> axial texture in CdTe face-centered cubic lattice and to the layerwise film growth. It has been shown that the optimal thickness of the “chloride treated” base layer in the thin film ITO/CdS/CdTe/Cu/Au solar cells (SC) equals 4 μm. The decreasing of CdTe film thickness leads to the SC efficiency decreasing as a result of the shunting resistance reduction, saturation diode current density and series resistance increasing. The CdTe film thickness growth leads to the SC efficiency decreasing because of the shunting resistance reduction and series resistance increasing. Experimentally approved the possibility of the deposition by close box method of the high-quality from the point of view of their structure CdTe base layers at the substrate temperatures in the range 300 - 450°C. It has been shown that for thin film glass/ITO/CdS/CdTe/Cu/Au SC optimal cadmium sulfide thickness equals 0.4 μm because of two competitive physical processes, namely, simultaneous variation of the diode saturation current density and the photocurrent density It has been experimentally demonstrated that the maximal efficiency of ITO/CdS/CdTe/Cu/Au SC corresponds to the 0,35 μm CdCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> thickness at “chloride treatment”. In this case both minimal series resistance and lowest diode saturation current density are achieved simultaneously.

articleTitle: Experimental Research of Effectiveness of Active Shielding System of Overhead Transmission Lines Magnetic Field with Various Control Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: Field experimental research of the effectiveness of single-circuit active shielding system of magnetic field generated by group of overhead high voltage power lines with various control algorithms carried out. It is shown that the efficiency of closed-loop system with feedback control, open-loop system with forward control and combine closed-loop and open-loop system with feed forward control is approximately the same and is more than 4 units. Experimentally established that effectiveness of closed-loop system with feedback control depends on the location of the magnetic field sensors in the shielding zone. Comparison of the results of experimental and calculated values of magnetic field induction in the shielding zone shows that their spread does not exceed 20%.

Author Keywords: high voltage power lines magnetic field

articleTitle: Distortion of an Optical Signal by a Recording Optoelectronic Device
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The results of modeling and comparison with experiment of distortions of signals registered by an optoelectronic device (OED) are presented in the work. Simulation is implemented in the Spyder environment in Python for various parameters (R, C) of the equivalent circuit of the OED. It is shown that the value of RC-circuit significantly affects the distortion of the output electrical signal with respect to the input optical signal. A criterion for RC-circuit parameters is established, under which the relative distortion of the signal does not exceed 2.5 percent. The simulation results are compared with the experimentally recorded signal when the optical pulse of the trapezoidal form is exposed to OED. It is shown that the use of an optical signal of a trapezoidal shape makes it possible to experimentally determine RC-circuit for real OED. The known value of the RC-circuit of real OED allows not only to evaluate the applicability of OED to control the shape of the optical signal, but also to reconstruct this form from the registered signal.

articleTitle: Research of the Influence of Input Voltage Deviations on the Pulse-Width Converter With Microprocessor Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: In this work, studies of the input voltage changes effect on the operation of a pulse-width constant voltage converter were carried out. The ways of reducing this influence with the help of microprocessor control systems combining deviation control with input disturbance control are analyzed. With the help of the mathematical model it is shown that under certain conditions of forming the control action, the input disturbances can be successfully compensated.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Supernominal Power Throws Factors on the Wind Turbine With Variable Speed
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: This paper are given the results studying of wind flow characteristics and the wind turbine impact on magnitude of the generator power throws with the implementation torque control of principal regulation variable speed wind turbine. The studies were carried out based on the generalized mathematical model of with using simulation experiment a wind turbine. The results of the study are presented in the form of graphs, constructed in relative coordinates. The obtained dependences make it possible to calculate the installed capacity of the elements of the electromechanical system of the wind turbine with variable speed taking into account the results of climate observations.

Author Keywords: torque control of control algorithm for wind turbines

articleTitle: The Increase in Efficiency of the Modes Power Resources Consumptions of the Processing Equipment of the Enterprises of Oil-processing Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The technique of static planning of an experiment for creation of mathematical model of energy consumption of technological plants of the enterprise of oil industry is offered that has allowed to analyze effectively the factors which influence the production and to optimize the expenses, to reduce the prime cost and to increase the overall performance of the enterprise in general. Bibl. 11, Fig. 4.

articleTitle: Contribution of Small Hydropower Plants in Regulation of Electric Energy Balance in Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The analysis of generating capacities structure and features of operating modes of the Ukraine combined power system is fulfilled. Priorities of hydropower development in Ukraine are highlighted, among them the important role is assigned to small hydroelectric power plants in providing power reserve of power systems. In order to determine the optimal distribution of small hydroelectric power plants power in order to cover the requirements of the power system load, the forecasting of electric power system load with the use of a multi-layered artificial neural network was fulfilled. The power of generators for small hydroelectric power plants to provide conditions for optimal load coverage in the power grid were determined.

articleTitle: Automatic Implantable Insulin Pump, adapted to Normal Activity of the Pancreas
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: It is proposed in the work and it is shown in numerical model experiments the possible software-model solution of the problem of elaborating an automatic control system for an implantable insulin pump, adapted to the real activity of the pancreas. The algorithm for managing the work of the best existing implantable insulin pumps is based on the concept of normoglycemia in the form of a range of its permissible values that ensure the absence of hypoglycemic conditions of the patient. This leads to the elimination of postprandial rising of glycemia in the patient, providing him with vital energy, or to the chronic hyperglycemia and the development of late dangerous complications of Diabetes mellitus. The proposed algorithm of the automatic control system of the insulin pump similar to the physiological system of carbohydrate exchange regulation, performs a triune function with the patient's free diet: avoiding both chronic hyperglycemia and chronic hypoglycemia as well as providing short-term hyperglycemic postprandial normal elevations in the glycemic levels. This result was achieved owing to that the dynamic setting of the normoglycemia is represented by the glycemic output of the physiologically adequate mathematical model of the system of carbohydrate exchange regulation with a real glucose absorption function in the patient's intestine.

articleTitle: The Optical and Electrical Properties ITO Thin Film
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The fulfilled optimization of ITO films for their using in the effective CdS/CdTe base solar cell design allowed to establish, that maximum figure of merit (8,0·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> Ohm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) is characteristic for the layers deposited at the substrate temperature 400°C. The optimization of the layer optical and electrical properties is ensured by the top main charge carrier mobility μ=44 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/(V·s) and the maximum transmittance of heterosystem ITO/Poly in the visible range T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">400-800</sub> = 0.61.

articleTitle: Research of the Electromagnetic Method for the Control Rolled Steel of the Same Grade of Various Manufacturer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: In the work the possibility of experimentally determining the differences in the characteristics of rolled of ferromagnetic steel in the process of its production and inspection test is considered. The electromagnetic converter of differential type with a ferrite core was developed to increase the sensitivity. As a result of experimental research using standard measuring equipment, good resolution ability has been obtained and it has been proved that it is possible to distinguish the properties of rolled steel of one grade manufactured at various plants, which ultimately improves the quality of the output products by making the inspection test.

articleTitle: Accounting for an Interconnection of Electrical, Magnetic and Mechanical Processes in Modeling the Dynamics of Turbomachines Rotors in Passive and Controlled Active Magnetic Bearings
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The work is devoted to the way of describing and modeling dynamic phenomena in rotor systems, in particular turbomachines, with magnetic bearings (MBs) of different types - the passive and active ones. The feature of such systems is an essential interconnection of processes having a different physical nature-mechanical, electrical and magnetic ones. To adequately reflect this relationship, the Lagrange-Maxwell equations are used, taking into account the laws governing the active magnetic bearings in them. A critical analysis of simplified methods for modeling rotor dynamics is given. For a correct consideration of electromagnetic processes, the method of analyzing electromagnetic circuits of active magnetic bearings (AMBs) is used, based on a consideration of substitution schemes. Magnetic resistances of magnetic circuits, grooves and air gaps are determined by schematizing the paths of magnetic fluxes. The power characteristics of passive magnetic bearings (PMBs) are determined on a basis of a series of magnetostatics analyzes. The refined analytical expressions for a magnetic energy of active magnetic bearings and the dependences of magnetic forces of passive magnetic bearings, found using the proposed approach, are used in the coupled Lagrange-Maxwell equations. A laboratory model is considered as an example of rotary systems with passive and active magnetic bearings, which is a prototype of a complete magnetic suspension of a rotor of an expander- compressor unit. Based on a comparison of the results of experimental studies and a numerical analysis of the rotor dynamics of this model, a substantiation and proof of a necessity of applying the proposed approaches are given.

articleTitle: High-speed Flywheel Energy Storage System (FESS) for Voltage and Frequency Support in Low Voltage Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The new-generation Flywheel Energy Storage System (FESS), which uses High-Temperature Superconductors (HTS) for magnetic levitation and stabilization, is a novel energy storage technology. Due to its quick response time, high power density, low losses, and large number of charging/discharging cycles, the high-speed FESS is especially suitable for enhancing power quality and transient stability in power systems. Real-time simulation of power systems and its components enables Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (PHIL) testing of new power system components, which is a cost-effective method to analyze the behavior of the component under different scenarios, prior to the grid connection. Having accurate real-time simulation models of the components is an essential step, prior to the PHIL testing. In this paper, the modeling and implementation of a FESS with HTS bearings in a real-time simulation environment is presented. The obtained real-time simulation results confirm the effectiveness of using such a FESS for improving power quality, e.g. voltage sag compensation in distribution networks and contributing to grid frequency regulation during frequency deviations.

articleTitle: Criteria based assessment of the level of ecological safety of exploitation of electric generating power plant that consumes biofuels
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: This paper describes the results of a comparative calculation of a complex criteria based assessment of the level of ecological safety of the process of exploitation of a electric generating power plant on the basis of a diesel internal combustion engine and an alternating current generator that consumes a renewable energy source, namely biofuels. Two stationary models of operation of such power plant are proposed on the basis of the daily diagram of the diesel generator's operation - for power supply of industrial and domestic objects. The physical and chemical properties of biofuels and their impact on the toxicity of exhaust gases are taken into account. The comparative description of the quantitative and qualitative aspects of the operation of the diesel generator on the proposed models of exploitation and effects from its transfer to the use of a renewable energy source is carried out.

articleTitle: Perfection of Methods for Constructing Remote Monitoring Systems for Patients in Emergency Situations
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: This work considers proposals for further improvement of remote monitoring systems for patients in emergency situations. The research was carried out on the basis of analysis of the features of primary medical care for patients in these conditions as well as modern capabilities of scientific and technical means. A method of parametric optimization of remote monitoring systems for patients in special conditions is proposed, using the generalized optimization criterion and the objective function of their effective functioning in the space of external and internal parameters.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Small-Scale Wind Turbine Converter’s Efficiency Built with Various Types of Semiconducting Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: Research in the field of power semiconductors led to creation of the commercially available wide bandgap switching devices, like Silicon Carbide based MOSFETs and Gallium-Nitride based HEMTs. The high switching frequencies with moderate losses, reduced conduction losses and excellent parasitic parameters with respect to comparable Silicon based devices allow using of them in efficiency sensitive systems. Utilization of the wide bandgap devices for renewable energy generation, as in case for small-scale wind turbines, provide valuable changes not only in the annual energy, but also in overall regulation parameters, thermal stress and, as a result, reliability of the system. This paper presents the comparative evaluation of the small-scale wind turbine performance using 650V Si MOSFETs, Si IGBTs, SiC MOSFETs and GaN HEMTs as switching devices. The chosen topology is based on the standard 2-level converter, consisting out of 3 phase half-bridges. The converter, designed for the actual load of 3 kW PMSM based wind generator is controlled by Direct Torque Control (DTC) principles. The influence of the torque and flux regulators settings, as well as wind speed distribution, is drawn in plots, based on efficiency surfaces and relative year efficiency graphs, repeated for each device. Relating to the simulation results, a comparative analysis is performed and conclusions about using of wide bandgap devices in the small scale windmill systems are drawn.

articleTitle: Optimization of Reactive Energy Flows in the Electric Grid Taking Into Account Allowable Voltage Fluctuations
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Energy and Power Systems (IEPS)
abstract: The work is devoted to solving the problem of optimization of allocation of additional reactive power sources (RPS) in distributed electrical networks (EN) on the criterion of maximum profitability of investments, taking into account allowable voltage fluctuations. The calculation of the extreme values of RPS is performed on the results of modelling the “ideal” EN modes according to the principle of least action. In order to take into account the economic aspects of the design problem, it is proposed to use economic resistances and obtain mathematical relationships for their determination. In order to take into account the constraints on voltage fluctuations in EN nodes, the extreme power of the RPS is corrected by the results of an additional optimization problem solution. For its formulation, the coefficients of the distribution of losses and elements of the Jacobi sensitivity matrix were used, which made it possible to linearize it. Unlike the methods of searching for variants, the application of such an approach significantly reduces the duration of calculations and allows you to obtain a solution that is as close as possible to the global extremum of the main target function.
